"Wind, wind, do not blow, let the soap bubbles fly away♪"

I'll drag you into all sorts of trouble.
Injuries... or even worse things.
This? ...Soap bubbles?
"Soap bubbles flew up high, up to the rooftop in the sky♪"
Yes...?
I see. ...You really are serious.

So please let the responsibility be mine.
Let everything be what I decided, what I chose to do—

It won't change, and it probably can't be changed.
Even so, if that's the case.

No problem, no problem! The kids always talk about how much they want to
hear Kei-chan play the piano. I'm sure they'll love it!

Thank you. Well then, one more song.
Let's see, what should we do—
! ...Trainer—
Oh, by the way, is it all right if I play the piano in the playroom?

Everything else can take a back seat. The future after she's gone,
or talk of there being a "next time"—all of it, for now.

Jeez, you're such a good girl. ...Oh, that reminds me, the race the other day!
You won, right? I heard from your doctor!

—Understood. That's an order for the latest research materials on post-training care,
and books covering nutritional management for small eaters, correct?
Please, let me bear the responsibility.

He praised you, saying you were super fast~
I wish I could have seen it too~!

...Um. I'm sorry to bring this up out of the blue.
But there's something I'd like to ask of you first.
"Let the soap bubbles fly away♪"

Yeah! Let's go with that song, then.
...——
...You've made up your mind, haven't you?

Ahaha. I'm self-taught, so it's really nothing fancy, but...
if it makes you happy, that makes me glad.

No, not at all.
This is just something I'm doing on my own.

...U-Um. ...That's... no way.
...Trainer... you're so much more than I ever imagined—

Understood. We will have them delivered to your Trainer Office within a week.
...Will you also be attending the upcoming trainers' workshop?

Here it is again, I think. The exact same demeanor she's shown all along.
K.S. Miracle is utterly and completely selfless.
...Ah. Little one, you've got something nice there.

With a body like mine... I've heard it many times from other trainers.
That even continuing my racing career safely might be difficult.

I don't want to burden you to that extent.
Taking up your present is one thing, but stealing your future too... I can't bear that.
Play more! I wanna hear more singing, too~!!

If something happens, you might end up taking the blame, Trainer.
...I've heard that you could even be forced to quit.
Through and through, ............you really are so kind.

Understood. I will send an email with the participation guidelines
sometime today, so please check it later.

Fufu. Once I debut, I'll be running a lot more...
I'd be so happy if you could come watch me someday.

Sorry about trying to scare you off before.
...Hang in there. I'm rooting for you!
Woaaah... Big sis, your piano is so pretty~...!!

And so, with a faint smile from K.S. Miracle,
our three-legged race of days began—

Whoa... That's an awful lot of materials.
Just getting back from a workshop?

It was after school on that very day
that K.S. Miracle and I officially signed our contract.
"Flew to the roof, popped, and vanished away..."
"Wind, oh wind, please do not blow..."

Oh, Kei-chan! You came to visit again!
You must be busy now that you have a trainer, so thank you so much.
